from k_slide.paas import *
from k_slide.execution import *

with TemporaryDirectory() as d:

    try: controller.status(c.identity)
    except KSlideError as e: print('wrong rejected',e.code,e.message,e.details)
    worker=PaaSWorker(service, worker_id='w', runtime_identity=R, engine=ReferenceWorkerEngine(), scope_context=ctx)
    print(worker.run_once().status)
    print(controller.queue().as_dict())
    print(worker.run_until_terminal(a.identity).status)
    print(controller.queue().as_dict())
    print(worker.run_until_terminal(b.identity).status)
    print(controller.queue().as_dict())
